ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT is entered into as of December Q, 2010 between NEW YORK CITY HOUSING AUTHORITY, a public benefit corporation' established under the laws of the State of New York,having an office at 250 Broadway, New York, New York 10007, including any successor in interest or assigns by act of the Authority, or by operation of law, or ·otherwise ("Owner"); NYC .PARTNERSHIP HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND COMPANY, INC.,a New York not-for-profit corporation duly organized pursuant'toArticleXI of thePrivate Housing FinanceLaw of theState of NewYork, and Section 402 of the Not-for Profit Corporation Law of the State of New York, having its principal office and place of business located at 450 Seventh Avenue,Suite 2401,New York, New York 10123 ("Record Title Holder”or"Nominal Owner"); and, FOREST HOUSE LLC, a limited liability company duly organized and existing under the laws of the State of New York, having its principal office and place of business located at c/o Blue Sea Development Company LLC, 164 Main Street, Huntington, New York 11743 ("Beneficial Owner” and together with Record Title Holder,“Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with.the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of the Bronx, City and State of New York, known as Block 2640Lot 1 on the TaxMap of theCity of NewYork,and commonly known as 735-770    r,  r a  s or      buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements or additions thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement, being called the “Owner's Building"); WHEREAS,Developeris theowner of certainland,withthebuilding and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of the Bronx, City and State of New York,known as Lot 50 in Block 2640 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and commonly known as 1071 Tinton Avenue, Bronx, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B"” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called “Developer's Property"); 、WHEREAS,Developer intends to clear the Developer's Property to construct thereon a new, approximately One Hundred Twenty Thousand Five Hundred and Twenty~Square Foot * (120,520sf) building, comprised of approximately One Hundred Twenty Three (123) units of affordable housing and One (1) non-revenue generating superintendant's unit and related improvements (such new building, as the same may be altered, modified, improved or replaced  from time to time, the “New Building"); WHEREAS, it is planned that the New Building will contain Fifty Four Thousand Nine Hundred Fifty Five Square Feet (54,955sf) more Floor Area than is now permitted to be constructed on the Developer's Property pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, the Owner desires to convey and the Developer desires to acquire the Transferred Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) so as to permit the construction of the New Buildings; NYC_MIDTOWNV13743378161101.000
